moworks.notes: Projectile: x = v·cosθ·t, y = v·sinθ·t − ½·g·t² (recipe v 250 px/s, θ 80°, g 500 px/s²), a pure function of time. Small demo: five balls launched 80 ms apart at 60 / 67 / 74 / 81 / 88°, v 190, g 300 (x scaled 0.9), each hidden once it reaches the floor. For confetti and thrown objects. Params: velocity (250 px/s) · angle (80°) · gravity (500 px/s²). x = v cos θ t, y = v sin θ t − ½ g t²: a pure function of time; each item hides once it reaches the floor. For confetti and thrown objects.
